name: Dexin Services Group Limited
summary: Dexin Services Group Limited is a Hangzhou-headquartered property manager serving Zhejiang, established in 2001 and owned by Shengfu International Limited. It provides security, cleaning, landscaping and repairs for residential and non-residential sites such as offices, schools, hospitals and industrial facilities. It also offers developers sales office management and inspections, and owners smart community, decoration and retail services.
